chunks: Those who were arrogant answered: "We do not believe in what you believe."

key_terms.الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا: Those who were arrogant / The leaders

ai.seo_question: How did the arrogant leaders of the disbelievers respond to their followers' acceptance of faith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the psychological rigidity of the elite (al-mustakbirun) who prioritize social status and political authority over spiritual truth, often rejecting faith to maintain their hierarchical dominance. It highlights the dynamic where leaders, fearing a loss of control, publicly disavow the very message their followers embraced, thereby severing the bond of shared belief to preserve their power. This reflects the broader Quranic theme of arrogance (istikbar) as a barrier to guidance, where pride prevents the recognition of divine signs.
